uq_users_email_active.name: uq_users_email_active
uq_users_email_active.where: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL

uq_users_phone_active.name: uq_users_phone_active
uq_users_phone_active.where: "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL

chk_conversations_context.name: chk_conversations_context
chk_conversations_context.value: (("conversations"."context_type" = 'ticket' AND "conversations"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."order_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversations"."context_type" = 'order' AND "conversations"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversations"."ticket_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversations"."context_type" = 'customer' AND "conversations"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "conversations"."order_id" IS NULL))
